decisions.briefing: Markets were flat today (NASDAQ +0.1%, S&P 500 +0.3%) with no clear risk-on signal. Cash on hand ($289.29) is below the $500 deployment threshold, so no new positions were added, and existing holdings were left to run per their stop-loss and profit-target rules.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices traded essentially flat today, with the NASDAQ up just 0.1% and the S&P 500 up 0.3%, reflecting a lack of strong directional catalysts. Without a decisive move in either direction, investors largely stayed on the sidelines rather than chasing new positions. This kind of low-volatility, range-bound session is common between major economic data releases or earnings catalysts.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走勢平淡，納斯達克指數僅上漲0.1%，標普500指數上漲0.3%，缺乏明顯的方向性催化劑。在市場沒有明確突破的情況下，投資人普遍選擇觀望，而非追高建倉。這種低波動、區間震盪的走勢，在重大經濟數據或財報公布之間相當常見。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Dry powder refers to cash kept on the sidelines, ready to deploy when a genuinely strong opportunity appears rather than being spent just to stay fully invested. On a neutral day like today, holding cash below the deployment threshold and waiting for a clearer signal is a disciplined choice, not a missed opportunity.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指的是投資人保留在場邊的現金，等待真正具吸引力的機會出現時才出手，而不是為了滿倉而勉強進場。像今天這種中性盤況，現金未達動用門檻時選擇持有觀望，是紀律的表現，而非錯失良機。
